synthesizedFacts.fact: Pore vacuums use gentle suction to remove debris, oil, and dead skin cells from pores.
Pore vacuums can improve the appearance of skin and minimize pore size but should be used cautiously.
Excessive suction from pore vacuums can cause skin damage such as bruising, broken blood vessels, and irritation.
Pore vacuums are more effective on already-loosened blackheads.
People with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin may experience irritation from pore vacuums.
